description: Adds what the business sells to the setup, each with its price as written, its page, what it is, and its pictures (file ids from add_pictures; or call add_pictures afterwards with the product's name). Products become the catalogue Marsell makes product pictures and posts from; services are named on the Brand page. The same name again changes that one. It takes any number of products. A big catalogue goes in batches: send as many in one call as fit in one message, then the next batch; if a call is refused as too big, send fewer at a time. Each call answers with the names it added and changed and how many products are on file; get_setup lists every product with its price and how many pictures it has.

products.description: One or more products or services; the same name again changes that one.

amount.description: The price as a number, when it has one.

category.description: Its collection or category, as the business groups it.

currency.description: Its ISO code: USD, EUR, GBP.

description.description: What it is and who it's for.

name.description: Its name, as the business writes it.

picture_file_ids.description: Pictures of it already added (add_pictures' file ids).

price.description: As the business writes it: "$29", "from 49 EUR a month".

name: add_products
title: Add products and services
